levels.title: First Light
levels.hint: Place matching colors beside each other. Three connected tiles clear.

levels.title: Small Sparks
levels.hint: Check NEXT before placing CURRENT. Leave room for the next color.

levels.title: Forest Echo
levels.hint: Matches connect up, down, left and right. Diagonals do not count.

levels.title: Falling Colors
levels.hint: After a match, tiles fall. Plan where the survivors will land.

levels.title: Chain Reaction
levels.hint: A second clear in one turn earns a cascade bonus.

levels.title: A Brighter Tomorrow
levels.hint: Restore the last colors of this opening chapter. Every placement matters.
